newsitem.title: USA: Two trucks carrying U.S. missiles, guns disappear.
newsitem.headline: Two trucks carrying U.S. missiles, guns disappear.

text.p: Two trucks carrying missiles, machineguns and mortars for the U.S. military disappeared in Texas on Thursday, officials said.

One truck was carrying four unarmed missiles when it vanished after last being seen on a highway about 80 miles (129 km) south of Dallas. A second truck had a 2,800-pound (1,270 kg) cargo of machineguns and mortars when it disappeared west of Austin.
An FBI agent said the missiles were not equipped with warheads so posed no immediate safety risk, but he added that an alert had been put out to find the truck.
Mike Cox, a spokesman with Texas' Department of Public Safety, also downplayed concerns surrounding the second truck, which was being tracked by military satellite when it disappeared.
"This does happen periodically," Cox said. "They don't consider this an emergency because there was no ammunition on the truck."
Both trucks belonged to private contractors who transport equipment for the armed forces.
